headline: Shield to Acquire Echodyne for $5.3 Billion in Radar and Drone Sector Expansion
summary: Shield entered into a definitive agreement to acquire radar company Echodyne Corp. in a transaction valued at $5.3 billion, alongside plans to raise $2.5 billion at a $28.8 billion valuation.
why: Large corporate acquisitions in the defense technology and radar sector reshape competitive dynamics and consolidate specialized engineering capabilities.
